notes: Concord Long-Burn Drive Mk2, a hull mount (outward is up): Mk1 plus pale-blue collar rings on the bell, regenerative cooling tubes up both flanks, a second band on each drum; inside a blue ring round the fuel-efficiency dial and a second small dial where the feed pipes were. Damaged: the bell lip dented and hanging, the bell cracked and sputtering, a cooling tube kinked, the right drum weeping pale fuel, the dial glass cracked, lamps red, sparks. Disabled: the bell bent over at the neck, a drum split and slid off, a cooling tube snapped, the dials dead, the repair hatch popped. THIS FILE: the INSIDE half (core, power coupling, repair hatch; its top 4px overhang the inner wall face as a flange). COMPACT (tier 1-2 parts take less room inside): this inside half is the centre of the original art between its own edge columns, re-outlined (art/_src/compact.py).
